rows.text: Across 357 language editions, new knowledge reaches Wikipedia through a process tracked by 12,863,931 live events. The largest by covered items list shows English (en) with 7,080,488 items covered at 39.76% coverage and a median lag of 1043.2 days, German (de) with 3,155,728 items at 17.72% and 1505.9 days, French (fr) with 2,708,117 items at 15.21% and 1788.4 days, Spanish (es) with 2,074,442 items at 11.65% and 1922.8 days, Russian (ru) with 1,951,394 items at 10.96% and 2099.7 days, and Italian (it) with 1,869,482 items at 10.5% and 1766.1 days. The shortest median lag list, limited to languages with at least 10,000 covered items, includes min with 228,326 items at 1.28% and 794.5 days, English (en) again at 1043.2 days, and Dutch (nl) with 1,383,705 items at 7.77% and 1392.7 days. The longest median lag list features tum with 14,230 items at 0.08% and 6863.9 days, lld with 181,702 items at 1.02% and 6233.2 days, and ku with 89,794 items at 0.5% and 6221.2 days. Lag is measured on Wikipedia only.
